demand_sensing_agent.systems: SAP S/4HANA FMCG · ITC e-Choupal Rural Agri Portal · APMC Mandi Feeds · Mother Godown WMS · BigQuery · Vertex AI TimesFM
demand_sensing_agent.problemDetails: Seasonal monsoon shifts, wheat and spice harvest arrival fluctuations, and volatile wholesale demand across 2M+ kirana retail stores create persistent regional stockouts and distributor inventory imbalances.
demand_sensing_agent.solutionDetails: PulseCast ingests daily e-Choupal farmgate arrivals, APMC mandi arrivals and spot prices, distributor order feeds, and weather patterns into Vertex AI TimesFM with hierarchical brand-pack reconciliation across Aashirvaad, Sunfeast, and Bingo! lines.
demand_sensing_agent.outcomeDetails: Prevents festive stockouts across rural Carrying & Forwarding Agents (CFAs); cuts forecast error by 24% and frees ₹45 Crore in trapped distributor working capital.

mps_finite_scheduler.systems: SAP S/4HANA PP/DS · Siemens Opcenter MES · ICML Integrated Plant SCADA · OSIsoft PI · OR-Tools CP-SAT
mps_finite_scheduler.problemDetails: Frequent recipe changes across high-speed biscuit baking lines, snack seasoning drums, and packaging conversions trigger excessive washdowns, dough wastage, and oven idling.
mps_finite_scheduler.solutionDetails: Orchestrates OR-Tools CP-SAT sequence-dependent setup optimization across ITC Integrated Consumer Goods Manufacturing and Logistics (ICML) plants, grouping similar dough and flavor profiles to minimize clean-in-place (CIP) turnaround.
mps_finite_scheduler.outcomeDetails: Increases effective line uptime by 14.8%; cuts product changeover waste by 34% and eliminates ₹18 Crore in annual packaging scrap.

category_should_cost.systems: SAP Ariba · ITC e-Choupal Sourcing Network · Agmarknet Mandi Index · BigQuery Commodity Models
category_should_cost.problemDetails: Procurement teams struggle to benchmark farmgate wheat, tobacco leaf, and packaging laminate quotes against volatile global commodity indices and domestic agricultural MSP policies.
category_should_cost.solutionDetails: Parametrically breaks down should-costs based on farmgate mandi arrivals, crop yield forecasts, moisture adjustments, diesel freight tariffs, and converting overheads.
category_should_cost.outcomeDetails: Unlocks ₹62 Crore in direct sourcing savings and establishes automated should-cost price corridors for e-Choupal procurement.

tier_n_spanner_graph.systems: Cloud Spanner Graph · ITC e-Choupal Village Kiosks · APMC Agri-Feeds · BigQuery GIS
tier_n_spanner_graph.problemDetails: Disruptions at regional agricultural cooperatives, localized crop diseases, and unseasonal rains stay invisible until procurement targets fall short at processing plants.
tier_n_spanner_graph.solutionDetails: Builds a live Cloud Spanner graph mapping 40,000+ village farming clusters, primary mandi aggregators, packaging converters, and ICML factory nodes with automated yield propagation.
tier_n_spanner_graph.outcomeDetails: Provides 14-day early warning on commodity supply deficits, dynamically rerouting procurement quotas to surplus agricultural districts.

working_capital_cash_bridge.solutionDetails: Generates an automated daily bridge between supply chain inventory velocity and corporate treasury cash flows, identifying high-toil stock points and rebalancing working capital.
working_capital_cash_bridge.outcomeDetails: Releases ₹85 Crore in enterprise working capital while improving service levels to retail distributors across Tier-2 and rural markets.
